content: The speed with which benchmarks become obsolete raises another important question: are current NLU models genuinely as good as their high performance on benchmarks suggests? A growing body of evidence shows that state-of-the-art models learn to exploit spurious statistical patterns in datasets BIBREF12, BIBREF13, BIBREF14, BIBREF15, BIBREF16, BIBREF17, instead of learning meaning in the flexible and generalizable way that humans do. Given this, human annotators—be they seasoned NLP researchers or non-experts—might easily be able to construct examples that expose model brittleness.
